bullets.text: The Spurs are 8-2 on an 8-game win streak and top the power rankings, with the Lakers and Thunder also 8-2 in the West.
Five teams are stuck at 1-7 or 1-8: the Bulls, Bucks, Jazz, Clippers and Kings, with the Jazz and Clippers on 7-game skids.
The Pelicans are 4-5 despite a +13 point differential, a record that trails how they have actually played.
